property_summary: For any valid call to fallback (exactly 10 ether, timestamp > pastBlockTime), the contract's balance afterward must be zero if and only if the block number is a multiple of 15; the buggy version inverts this, making the balance zero when block.number % 15 != 0 instead.
change_summary: Replace the condition block.number % 15 == 0 with block.number % 15 != 0, inverting the payout logic.
